items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: They gave me long, long pants. Skeeter, Jackson, and Sola.

ctx.x: Yeah, he used to play bass. He played for you. Yeah, he used to play guitar with me too. We didn't carry him long, you know. Yeah. He used to play guitar and bass. Yeah. And that's the time you all carried him in the country, eh? Oh yeah. They carried me. They carried me. They carried me. They made the whole grinding and displayed from place to place. And the name was on the book, the grinding was wrong with the fellas, the fellas dropped much money as the fellas was working at the field.

They gave me long pants to come. Yeah, I was in charge. They gave me long, long pants. Skeeter, Jackson, and Sola. Yeah. Yeah. They got a... Zuku, eh? One of them fishing poles. Henry poles. Henry poles. Henry poles. Henry poles. And I took it and bored me, cut me two holes in there and that brown smoking paper. Yeah.
